hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); node "$r/bin/vstack.mjs" hook pre-edit --harness claude || exit 2'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); node "$r/bin/vstack.mjs" hook post-edit --harness claude'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); node "$r/bin/vstack.mjs" hook stop --harness claude || printf "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Veristack stop hook failed closed\"}\n"'
